definitions.supplemental: ? the word in the passage is not feminine

quotations.old_english: Gáþ þá oþræ v. hída forð mid . . . mid eallum þingum swá hit þonnæ stænt bútan æ-lcon geántalæ

quotations.latin: in vita mea. Post autem sine contradictions reciperent sua

source_text: geán-talu (? the word in the passage is not feminine), e; f. Gain-saying, contradiction, dispute, objection :-- G&a-long; þ&a-long; oþræ v. h&i-long;da for&d-bar; mi&d-bar; . . . mid eallum þingum sw&a-long; hit þonnæ stænt b&u-long;tan æ-long;lcon geántalæ, Cht. Th. 587, 24. B&u-long;ten alken g&e-long;ntale, 594, 11. Cf. . . . in vita mea. Post autem sine contradictions reciperent sua, 600, 31.
